ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
notes: sign convention (share_issuance): issuance proceeds filed below zero beside positive facts of the same fiscal year, so the value filed below zero is a sign-convention error in the filing — quarter ended 2023-12-31: the filed facts 2023-01-01..2023-12-31 = 278,000 and 2023-01-01..2023-09-30 = -262,000 carry a sign below zero — |278,000| − |-262,000| = 16,000 used (the quarterly row read 540,000)

share_issuance: quarters left out — quarter ended 2023-09-30: the quarterly row read 36,000 from facts filed with opposite signs (2023-01-01..2023-09-30 = -262,000 and 2023-01-01..2023-06-30 = -298,000) and no consistent figure can be rebuilt — left out (a missing quarter)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.22 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.305, 2026-06-30: 0.305) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.305, 2025-06-30: 0.305)

warnings: revenue basis: the filer's own total (Revenues / RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense) for every period — it exceeds the contract-revenue line, which is a component for this filer
